To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we can use the features extracted from a pretrained CNN model on a large dataset like ImageNet to cluster images into classes and use the same model to classify images into classes.

1) CNN features extracted from global average layer of pre-trained deep CNN models are suitable for clustering images into broad classes, and 2) SVM classification of CNN features extracted from images of a specific class can help in automated state diagnosis.
we propose a novel method for image classification and tagging using CNN features for participatory sensing in agriculture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework for automated image classification using deep learning and its integration with participatory sensing applications to support decision-making by farmers.
the development of a scalable and robust system to perform image clustering and classification for large datasets.

    - Coarse clustering and coarse classification of images

this paper presents a method to perform coarse clustering and classification of images using features extracted from CNNs, which can be used to auto-tag images captured by farmers and support experts to provide timely and appropriate advisories.
the proposed approach of coarse clustering and fine classification is a novel approach for image tagging for participatory sensing in agriculture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to achieve an overall accuracy of 92% for coarse clustering of 5 classes and an accuracy of 93.75 % in fine-grained classification of tea leaves images into 3 classes.
we propose a solution to perform unsupervised image classification by leveraging the high-level features extracted from a pretrained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN).
we have developed an automated image classification system that can be deployed in the field for participatory sensing of images in agriculture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the features from the pre-trained CNN models trained on ImageNet can be effectively used for image clustering and coarse classification.
the high level features from CNN trained on large scale image datasets can be used to perform unsupervized image classification and coarse clustering of images.
CNN features are useful for coarse clustering and classification of images in uncontrolled conditions.
